reviews.title: working great, wish they are a little quiet
reviews.comment:
I was looking for HDDs for my Ugreen NAS, bought a Seagate Ironwolf Pro 20TB when on sale, but DOA, so returned it to BestBuy and tried to find a replacement. The price of the 20TB went back to the original, eventually I settled with the 16TB. 
I bought two 16TB for my NAS, so far they have been working great. It's a bit loud though when the hard drives are working.
reviews.author: Steven
